query: My son is in class 8 at a government school in Bihar. He is good at studies and our family earns about 2 lakh a year. Is there a scholarship for him?
reference_answer: He may be eligible for the National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMSS). Students in government schools with family income up to Rs 3.5 lakh can take the selection test in Class 8; selected students get Rs 12,000 a year from Class 9 to Class 12.

query: I scored in the top 10 percent of my class 12 board and just joined a BA degree in Lucknow. My family earns 3 lakh a year. Any scholarship for me?
reference_answer: You may be eligible for the PM-USP Central Sector Scholarship: it is for students above the 80th percentile in Class 12 with family income up to Rs 4.5 lakh, and pays Rs 12,000 a year for the first three years of graduation.

query: My daughter is 6 and we are a poor family in Jaipur. Can she study for free in a private school?
reference_answer: Under the Right to Education Act, private unaided schools keep 25% of Class 1 seats for children from weaker or disadvantaged families living nearby. She may be eligible for free education there until elementary school is complete.

query: My son is 8 and studies in class 3 at a government school in Patna. Does he get free food at school?
reference_answer: Yes, under PM POSHAN children in Classes 1 to 8 in government and government-aided schools get one free hot cooked meal on every school working day.

query: My father needs an operation and we cannot pay the hospital. We are a poor family in Indore.
reference_answer: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY may help: eligible poor families get up to Rs 5 lakh a year of cashless hospital treatment at empanelled hospitals.

query: My grandmother is 74 and lives with us in Chennai. Can she get free hospital treatment?
reference_answer: She may be eligible under Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY: everyone aged 70 or above is covered whatever their income, through the Ayushman Vay Vandana Card, with up to Rs 5 lakh of hospital care a year.

query: My father is 67 and has no income. We are a BPL family in Odisha. Is there a monthly pension for him?
reference_answer: He may be eligible for the Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension: people aged 60 or above from BPL families get Rs 200 a month from the Centre for ages 60 to 79, and states add their own top-up.

query: We live in a village in Jharkhand and need daily wage work. I am 35. Is there a scheme that guarantees work?
reference_answer: VB-G RAM G, which replaced MGNREGA, gives rural households up to 125 days of paid unskilled work a year, with wages paid into a bank or post office account and an unemployment allowance if work is not given in time.

query: I am 20 and want a free short course with a certificate to get a job. I live in Nagpur.
reference_answer: PMKVY 4.0 under Skill India offers free short-term skill training for ages 15 to 45, with a skill certificate after you pass the assessment.

query: My brother is 30 and needs a wheelchair. He has a 60% disability certificate and our family income is 15,000 rupees a month. We live in Kanpur.
reference_answer: He may be eligible under the ADIP scheme: people with 40% or more disability and income up to Rs 22,500 a month get the full cost of the aid paid.

query: We do not have enough grain at home. How can we get free ration? We live in Gaya.
reference_answer: Under the National Food Security Act and PMGKAY, priority households get 5 kg of grain per person a month free, and Antyodaya families get 35 kg. Ration cards are issued by your State food department.

query: I am a small farmer, 45 years old, with 1 acre of land in my name in Vidisha. Is there yearly money from the government?
reference_answer: PM-KISAN gives landholding farmer families Rs 6,000 a year in three instalments of Rs 2,000, paid directly into the bank account.

query: We live in a kutcha house in our village in Madhya Pradesh. I am 40. We want to build a pucca house.
reference_answer: PMAY-Gramin helps rural families with no house or a kutcha house: Rs 1.20 lakh to build in plain areas, plus Rs 12,000 for a toilet and 90 to 95 days of paid work to build your own house.

query: We rent a room in Mumbai. Our family income is 2.5 lakh a year and we have no house anywhere. I am 33.
reference_answer: PMAY-Urban 2.0 may help: urban EWS families with income up to Rs 3 lakh and no pucca house get at least Rs 2.5 lakh from Centre and State to build or buy a low-cost house.

query: We still cook on wood. I am a 30 year old woman from an SC family in Bihar. Can we get a free gas connection?
reference_answer: You may be eligible for Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana: women aged 18 or above from SC and other listed poor households with no LPG connection get the connection paid for, with the first refill and stove free.

query: I am 25 and do not have a bank account. Can I open one with zero balance? I live in Ranchi.
reference_answer: Yes, under Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana you can open an account with no minimum balance and get a free RuPay debit card with accident insurance.

query: I am 60 years old and want cheap accident insurance. I have a savings account in Surat.
reference_answer: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana covers people aged 18 to 70 with a savings account: Rs 2 lakh for accidental death or full disability and Rs 1 lakh for partial disability.

query: I am 28, I work as a daily labourer in Delhi and I want a pension when I am old.
reference_answer: Atal Pension Yojana is for people aged 18 to 40 with a savings account. You choose a pension of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 a month from age 60.

query: I am a 38 year old carpenter in Jaipur working with my own tools. I need training and a toolkit.
reference_answer: PM Vishwakarma supports artisans in 18 trades: basic training with Rs 500 a day stipend, a toolkit worth up to Rs 15,000, and loans without collateral at 5 percent interest.

query: My wheat crop could be ruined by heavy rain this year. I am a farmer in Punjab, 50 years old. Is there crop insurance?
reference_answer: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana insures notified crops; the farmer pays at most 1.5% of the insured amount for Rabi food crops like wheat, and the government pays the rest.

query: I want to start a new small manufacturing unit in Ludhiana and heard the government gives a subsidy on the loan. I am 32.
reference_answer: The Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) gives bank-linked finance with a government margin-money subsidy for eligible new micro-enterprises.

query: I am a woman in a village in Bihar and want to join a self help group to get a loan. I am 29.
reference_answer: DAY-NRLM brings women from poor rural households into Self Help Groups. Women SHGs can get bank loans up to Rs 3 lakh at 7 percent interest, plus training and support for small businesses.

query: I am 23, pregnant, and will deliver at the government hospital in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. Will I get any money?
reference_answer: In Uttar Pradesh, Janani Suraksha Yojana gives all women who deliver in a government hospital Rs 1,400 in villages or Rs 1,000 in cities.

query: I am 26 and pregnant, living in Bhopal. How many free check-ups can I get during pregnancy?
reference_answer: Under SUMAN, pregnant women get at least 4 free pregnancy check-ups at government health facilities, plus a free check-up on the 9th of every month under PMSMA.

query: My sister is a widow in Kolkata and cannot afford to raise her 9 year old son. Is there monthly support for the child?
reference_answer: Under Mission Vatsalya, a child of a widow may get sponsorship of Rs 4,000 a month to stay with the family, if family income is under Rs 72,000 a year in villages or Rs 96,000 elsewhere.

query: My son is 2 years old and underweight. We live in Raipur. Can we get free nutrition food for him?
reference_answer: Under Saksham Anganwadi and POSHAN 2.0, children from 6 months to 3 years get free take-home ration twice a month from the Anganwadi Centre. You only need to register there.

query: I am an OBC student and got admission to a top engineering college. Our family income is 2 lakh a year. I live in Hyderabad.
reference_answer: You may be eligible for PM-YASASVI Top Class College Education: OBC, EBC and DNT students in notified institutions with family income up to Rs 2.5 lakh get full tuition, Rs 3,000 a month for living costs, and a one-time Rs 45,000 for a laptop.

query: My daughter is in class 9 at a government school in Agra. We are OBC and our income is 1.5 lakh a year.
reference_answer: She may be eligible for the PM-YASASVI Pre-Matric Scholarship: OBC, EBC and DNT students in Class 9 or 10 at government schools with family income up to Rs 2.5 lakh get Rs 4,000 a year.

query: I lost my father to COVID and I am in the first year of an engineering diploma in Pune. Is there a scholarship?
reference_answer: You may be eligible for the AICTE-Swanath Scholarship: students in AICTE-approved courses who lost a parent to Covid-19, with family income up to Rs 8 lakh, get Rs 50,000 a year.

query: I am a girl starting B.Tech this year in Bhubaneswar. My family income is 5 lakh. Any scholarship for girls?
reference_answer: You may be eligible for the AICTE Pragati Scholarship for girls in AICTE-approved degree courses with family income up to Rs 8 lakh. It gives Rs 50,000 a year for up to 4 years.

query: I have 50% disability and just got admission in first year B.Tech in Chennai. Any scholarship for me?
reference_answer: You may be eligible for the AICTE Saksham Scholarship: students with 40% or more disability in AICTE-approved degree courses, with family income up to Rs 8 lakh, get Rs 50,000 a year. Every eligible student gets it.

query: My husband was the only earner in our family and he died last month at age 45. We are a BPL family in Varanasi. Is there any help?
reference_answer: The National Family Benefit Scheme may help: BPL households whose main earner died between the ages of 18 and 60 can get a one-time payment of Rs 20,000.

query: My son is 25 and has 85% disability. We are a BPL family in Nashik. Is there a pension for him?
reference_answer: He may be eligible for the Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension: BPL adults with 80% or more disability get Rs 300 a month from the Centre, and states add their own top-up.

query: I am 19, I passed ITI, and I want an apprenticeship with a stipend. I live in Coimbatore.
reference_answer: Under the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme the company pays a monthly stipend and the government adds 25% of it, up to Rs 1,500 a month, for apprentices aged 35 or younger.

query: I used to clean septic tanks by hand in Gorakhpur and now I want to start my own business. I am 42.
reference_answer: Under NAMASTE, manual scavengers and sanitation workers can get free skill training with a Rs 3,000 a month stipend and a subsidy of up to Rs 5 lakh on self-employment projects.

query: I want to save money for my 4 year old daughter's education. We live in Kochi.
reference_answer: A Sukanya Samriddhi Account can be opened for a girl below 10. Interest was 8.2% a year up to 30 September 2026, deposits get tax deduction, and up to 50% can be taken out for her education after she turns 18 or passes Class 10.

query: I am a woman living in Delhi and my husband is violent. Where can I get legal help and a safe place to stay?
reference_answer: One Stop Centres help women facing violence with medical aid, legal aid, police help, counselling and temporary shelter for up to 5 days. Women Helpline 181 works 24x7; call 112 if you are in immediate danger.

query: मेरा बेटा सरकारी स्कूल में आठवीं कक्षा में है और पढ़ाई में अच्छा है। हमारी सालाना आमदनी 2 लाख है, हम बिहार में रहते हैं। क्या कोई छात्रवृत्ति है?
reference_answer: उसे National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMSS) मिल सकती है। सरकारी स्कूल के छात्र, जिनकी पारिवारिक आय 3.5 लाख रुपये तक है, आठवीं कक्षा में परीक्षा दे सकते हैं; चुने गए छात्रों को नौवीं से बारहवीं तक हर साल 12,000 रुपये मिलते हैं।

query: मेरे पिताजी का ऑपरेशन होना है और हम अस्पताल का खर्च नहीं उठा सकते। हम गरीब परिवार हैं और इंदौर में रहते हैं।
reference_answer: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY से मदद मिल सकती है: पात्र गरीब परिवारों को सूचीबद्ध अस्पतालों में हर साल 5 लाख रुपये तक का कैशलेस इलाज मिलता है।

query: मेरी माँ 68 साल की हैं और हम बीपीएल परिवार हैं, ओडिशा में रहते हैं। क्या उन्हें पेंशन मिल सकती है?
reference_answer: उन्हें Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension मिल सकती है: बीपीएल परिवार के 60 साल या उससे अधिक उम्र के लोगों को केंद्र से 79 साल तक 200 रुपये महीना मिलते हैं, और राज्य अपनी ओर से राशि जोड़ते हैं।

query: हम झारखंड के एक गाँव में रहते हैं और मज़दूरी का काम चाहिए। मेरी उम्र 35 साल है। क्या कोई योजना है जिसमें काम की गारंटी हो?
reference_answer: VB-G RAM G, जिसने MGNREGA की जगह ली है, ग्रामीण परिवारों को साल में 125 दिन तक मज़दूरी वाला काम देती है। समय पर काम न मिले तो बेरोज़गारी भत्ता मिलता है।

query: मैं 45 साल का छोटा किसान हूँ, मेरे नाम पर एक एकड़ ज़मीन है, विदिशा में। क्या सरकार से हर साल पैसा मिलता है?
reference_answer: PM-KISAN में ज़मीन वाले किसान परिवारों को साल में 6,000 रुपये, 2,000 रुपये की तीन किस्तों में, सीधे बैंक खाते में मिलते हैं।

query: हमारा मध्य प्रदेश के गाँव में कच्चा घर है, मेरी उम्र 40 साल है। हमें पक्का घर बनवाना है।
reference_answer: PMAY-Gramin में बेघर या कच्चे घर वाले ग्रामीण परिवारों को मैदानी इलाकों में घर बनाने के लिए 1.20 लाख रुपये, शौचालय के लिए 12,000 रुपये और अपना घर बनाने के लिए 90 से 95 दिन का मज़दूरी वाला काम मिलता है।

query: हम अभी भी लकड़ी पर खाना बनाते हैं। मैं 30 साल की अनुसूचित जाति की महिला हूँ, बिहार में। क्या मुफ्त गैस कनेक्शन मिल सकता है?
reference_answer: आपको Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana मिल सकती है: बिना LPG कनेक्शन वाले अनुसूचित जाति और अन्य सूचीबद्ध गरीब परिवारों की 18 साल से ऊपर की महिलाओं को कनेक्शन का खर्च सरकार देती है, और पहली रिफिल व चूल्हा मुफ्त मिलता है।

query: हमारे घर में खाने के लिए पूरा अनाज नहीं है। मुफ्त राशन कैसे मिलेगा? हम गया में रहते हैं।
reference_answer: National Food Security Act और PMGKAY के तहत प्राथमिकता वाले परिवारों को हर व्यक्ति को हर महीने 5 किलो अनाज मुफ्त मिलता है, और अंत्योदय परिवारों को 35 किलो। राशन कार्ड राज्य का खाद्य विभाग बनाता है।

query: मेरे भाई की उम्र 30 साल है और उसे व्हीलचेयर चाहिए। उसके पास 60% विकलांगता का प्रमाण पत्र है और हमारी आमदनी 15,000 रुपये महीना है। हम कानपुर में रहते हैं।
reference_answer: ADIP योजना से मदद मिल सकती है: 40% या अधिक विकलांगता वाले लोगों को, जिनकी आय 22,500 रुपये महीना तक है, उपकरण का पूरा खर्च मिलता है।

query: मैं 60 साल का हूँ और मुझे सस्ता दुर्घटना बीमा चाहिए। सूरत में मेरा बचत खाता है।
reference_answer: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana 18 से 70 साल के बचत खाता धारकों के लिए है: दुर्घटना में मृत्यु या पूरी विकलांगता पर 2 लाख रुपये और आंशिक विकलांगता पर 1 लाख रुपये।

query: मैं 28 साल का दिहाड़ी मज़दूर हूँ, दिल्ली में रहता हूँ। मुझे बुढ़ापे के लिए पेंशन चाहिए।
reference_answer: Atal Pension Yojana 18 से 40 साल के बचत खाता धारकों के लिए है। आप 60 साल की उम्र से 1,000 से 5,000 रुपये महीने तक की पेंशन चुन सकते हैं।

query: मेरी बेटी 4 साल की है, हम कोच्चि में रहते हैं। उसकी पढ़ाई के लिए बचत करनी है।
reference_answer: 10 साल से कम उम्र की बेटी के लिए Sukanya Samriddhi Account खोला जा सकता है। 30 सितंबर 2026 तक ब्याज 8.2% सालाना था, और 18 साल की होने या दसवीं पास करने के बाद पढ़ाई के लिए 50% तक पैसा निकाला जा सकता है।

query: मैं 38 साल का बढ़ई हूँ, जयपुर में अपने औज़ारों से काम करता हूँ। मुझे ट्रेनिंग और टूलकिट चाहिए।
reference_answer: PM Vishwakarma में कारीगरों को 500 रुपये रोज़ के भत्ते के साथ ट्रेनिंग, 15,000 रुपये तक की टूलकिट, और 5 प्रतिशत ब्याज पर बिना गारंटी का लोन मिलता है।

query: मेरा बेटा 2 साल का है और उसका वज़न कम है। हम रायपुर में रहते हैं। क्या मुफ्त पोषण आहार मिल सकता है?
reference_answer: Saksham Anganwadi और POSHAN 2.0 के तहत 6 महीने से 3 साल तक के बच्चों को आंगनवाड़ी केंद्र से महीने में दो बार मुफ्त राशन मिलता है। बस वहाँ नाम दर्ज कराना होता है।

query: मेरी बेटी आगरा के सरकारी स्कूल में नौवीं कक्षा में है। हम ओबीसी हैं और हमारी आमदनी 1.5 लाख रुपये सालाना है।
reference_answer: उसे PM-YASASVI Pre-Matric Scholarship मिल सकती है: सरकारी स्कूल में नौवीं या दसवीं में पढ़ने वाले ओबीसी, ईबीसी और डीएनटी छात्रों को, जिनकी पारिवारिक आय 2.5 लाख रुपये तक है, साल में 4,000 रुपये मिलते हैं।

query: मेरी बेटी इस साल भुवनेश्वर में बी.टेक में दाखिला ले रही है। परिवार की आमदनी 5 लाख है। क्या लड़कियों के लिए कोई छात्रवृत्ति है?
reference_answer: उसे AICTE Pragati Scholarship मिल सकती है: AICTE से मान्य डिग्री कोर्स में पढ़ने वाली लड़कियों को, जिनकी पारिवारिक आय 8 लाख रुपये तक है, 4 साल तक हर साल 50,000 रुपये मिलते हैं।

query: मैं 23 साल की हूँ, गर्भवती हूँ और लखनऊ, उत्तर प्रदेश के सरकारी अस्पताल में डिलीवरी कराऊँगी। क्या कोई पैसा मिलेगा?
reference_answer: उत्तर प्रदेश में Janani Suraksha Yojana के तहत सरकारी अस्पताल में डिलीवरी कराने वाली सभी महिलाओं को गाँव में 1,400 रुपये या शहर में 1,000 रुपये मिलते हैं।

query: मैं बिहार के गाँव की 29 साल की महिला हूँ। स्वयं सहायता समूह से जुड़कर लोन लेना चाहती हूँ।
reference_answer: DAY-NRLM गरीब ग्रामीण परिवारों की महिलाओं को स्वयं सहायता समूह से जोड़ता है। महिला समूहों को 7 प्रतिशत ब्याज पर 3 लाख रुपये तक का बैंक लोन मिल सकता है।

query: I am 24 and pregnant with my first child. We have a BPL ration card and live in Pune. Is there any money support?
reference_answer: You may be eligible for PMMVY, which gives Rs 5,000 for the first child in two parts, and for Janani Suraksha Yojana, which in Maharashtra gives BPL women who deliver in a government hospital Rs 700 in villages or Rs 600 in cities.

query: I am 35 with a savings account in Indore. I want insurance so my family gets money if something happens to me.
reference_answer: Two options may fit: PMJJBY pays your nominee Rs 2 lakh if you die from any cause, for people who join between 18 and 50; PMSBY pays Rs 2 lakh for accidental death or full disability, for ages 18 to 70.

query: I sell vegetables from a street cart in Delhi and need a small loan for my business. I am 34.
reference_answer: PM SVANidhi gives eligible street vendors working-capital loans without collateral. Mudra Shishu loans of up to Rs 50,000 are also available for small businesses; it is a loan to be repaid, with no subsidy.

query: I am a 30 year old farmer with 1 hectare of land in Nashik. Is there a pension scheme for my old age?
reference_answer: PM Kisan Maandhan gives small and marginal farmers aged 18 to 40 a minimum pension of Rs 3,000 a month after 60. Atal Pension Yojana is another option, with a chosen pension of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 a month from 60.

query: I want to start a small dairy business in Anand and need a loan of about 3 lakh rupees. I am 31.
reference_answer: A Mudra Kishor loan covers business loans above Rs 50,000 up to Rs 5 lakh, including dairy. PMEGP is another option for a new micro-enterprise, with a government margin-money subsidy on the loan.

query: I am 27 and pregnant in Patna. Is a caesarean delivery free at the government hospital, and will they give transport?
reference_answer: Yes. Under JSSK, normal and caesarean deliveries are free at government hospitals, with free medicines, food and transport from home and back. SUMAN also provides a free ambulance on 102 or 108.

query: My baby is 3 months old and sick. We live in Ranchi. Is treatment free at the government hospital?
reference_answer: Yes. Under JSSK and SUMAN, sick newborns and babies up to 1 year get free treatment, medicines and tests at government hospitals, with free transport.

query: I am a registered construction worker in Uttar Pradesh. My wife needs kidney treatment that we cannot afford.
reference_answer: The UP Gambhir Bimari Sahayata Yojana repays the full treatment cost for registered construction workers and their spouse, if they are not eligible for Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY. If you are eligible for PM-JAY, it covers up to Rs 5 lakh a year of hospital care.

query: I am 20, passed class 12 in Kota, and want free training that leads to a job.
reference_answer: PMKVY 4.0 offers free short-term skill training with a certificate. An apprenticeship under NAPS is another route: the company pays a stipend and the government adds 25%, up to Rs 1,500 a month.

query: We are a poor family in a village in Bihar. We need a pucca house and also a gas connection. I am a 36 year old woman.
reference_answer: PMAY-Gramin gives Rs 1.20 lakh to build a house in plain areas, plus Rs 12,000 for a toilet. Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana pays for an LPG connection for eligible women from poor households, with the first refill and stove free.

query: I am a 72 year old man in Lucknow with no income. We are BPL. I need a pension and free hospital treatment.
reference_answer: You may be eligible for the Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension, Rs 200 a month from the Centre plus a state top-up for BPL people aged 60 to 79, and for Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY, which covers everyone 70 or above with up to Rs 5 lakh of hospital care a year.

query: I am a 21 year old girl whose father died in an accident. I am starting a B.Tech degree. Our income is 4 lakh.
reference_answer: Two AICTE scholarships may fit, each Rs 50,000 a year: Swanath, for students who lost a parent in an accident, and Pragati, for girls in degree courses. Since August 2026 they can be taken together.

query: मैं 35 साल का हूँ, इंदौर में बचत खाता है। मुझे ऐसा बीमा चाहिए कि मुझे कुछ हो जाए तो परिवार को पैसा मिले।

reference_answer: हाँ, JSSK और SUMAN के तहत एक साल तक के बीमार बच्चों का सरकारी अस्पताल में इलाज, दवाइयाँ और जाँच मुफ्त हैं, और आने-जाने की सुविधा भी मुफ्त है।

reference_answer: PM Kisan Maandhan में 18 से 40 साल के छोटे किसानों को 60 साल के बाद कम से कम 3,000 रुपये महीना पेंशन मिलती है। Atal Pension Yojana भी एक विकल्प है, जिसमें 60 साल से 1,000 से 5,000 रुपये महीना पेंशन चुनी जा सकती है।
